verdict: Ads are reaching people; conversion tracking is broken and being fixed.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $624.81 was spent on Google Ads, producing 132 clicks and 683 website sessions — but zero leads were recorded. The findings are clear that this is a tracking failure, not an ad performance failure: real interest is arriving (including 49 direction requests from your Google Business Profile), but the intake path is not capturing it. Conversion tracking repair and a full end-to-end stack test are underway now. Once tracking is confirmed live, the true lead volume will become visible and the campaign can be optimised properly.

highlights.phrase: spent on Google Ads this period, with 683 website sessions reached
leads recorded this period — due to a broken conversion tracking path, not absent traffic
direction requests from your Google Business Profile, confirming organic interest is real

watch_item.issue: Conversion tracking is not capturing leads at any touchpoint — paid or organic — so the reported lead count under-reports actual enquiries.
watch_item.fix: A full end-to-end tracking test and paid landing page fix are in progress this week, with verified money paths targeted by end of September.
